messages:
alyssa_cs: Heads-up from today's health scan 1: three customers showing onboarding stalls + early renewal risk. proposing a focused 7-day "reactivate loop" per account instead of a full escalation.

alyssa_cs: Quick play: 1) 20m SE triage + immediate fixes, 2) 7-day soft quota bump or $300 credit, 3) tailored exec note + one-pager. run small experiments, capture signal on day 3 and day 7.

ben_se: I can take the SE triage for AcroSync (highest ARR + renewal in 12 days). will book a 20m call and run a short checklist.

marta_data: Signal here's what flipped: AcroSync embedding calls down 60% last 5 days, onboarding job retries > 5x. SQL I ran: 
```
SELECT account_id, metric, pct_change FROM account_signals WHERE account_id='acrosync' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 20;
```

chris_ops: I can approve a temporary 7-day quota bump for AcroSync. opening ticket OPS-2045 now and linking here.

notify_bot: Risk alert: acrosync flagged at 2026-04-02T08:14:00Z for CHURN-P1 (renewal_imminent + onboarding_failures).

alyssa_cs: Timeline: Day 0 open OPS-2045, SE call Day 1, apply credit/quota Day 2, monitor Day 3 & Day 7. success metric = +15% API calls or onboarding jobs resolved.

ben_se: I'll paste the triage checklist after the call and any quick config diffs.

marta_data: I'll throw together a dashboard card for these reactivate-loop accounts and a small alert if success_rate < 85%.

chris_ops: OPS-2045 created: https://jira.redwood/OPS-2045 1 - 7-day bump granted.

alyssa_cs: owners: AcroSync = ben_se, MeridianApps = alyssa_cs, BrightHarbor = marta_data. please react with :white_check_mark: when done.

ben_se: :white_check_mark: scheduled SE triage for AcroSync 2026-04-03 09:30 PT.

marta_data: :white_check_mark: dashboard card pushed.

alyssa_cs: thanks team 1 we'll reconvene after day 7 and decide if we escalate to renewal concessions.
